اشترطوا (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَطُوا (ištaraṭū) /iʃ.ta.ra.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# اُشْتُرِطُوا (ušturiṭū) /uʃ.tu.ri.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
# اِشْتَرِطُوا (ištariṭū) /iʃ.ta.ri.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِشْتَرَطَ (ištaraṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
